evals.prompt: Revise an existing skill whose SKILL.md contains floating prose, duplicated AGENTS.md rules, and no contrasting examples.
evals.expected_output: Read references/skill-authoring-standard.md, snapshot the skill, rewrite SKILL.md in imperative execution order under 500 lines, move variants to references/, add good-vs-bad examples in examples/, add evals/evals.json, and re-read the final files.
expectations: Uses imperative step-by-step execution order in SKILL.md
Provides contrasting good vs bad examples and objective evals.json

evals.prompt: Optimize the trigger description of a skill using 20 realistic trigger queries.
evals.expected_output: Create 8-10 positive and 8-10 adjacent negative queries, run scripts.run_loop when supported, apply best_description only if held-out score improves, and report before/after scores.
expectations: Includes 8-10 positive and 8-10 adjacent negative queries
Applies best_description only when held-out score improves
